title: Rehearsal route: the shortest documented route to a visible result
description: Produced by per-route discovery (one model call, structured output) from the catalogue route chosen by the person (route-catalogue-spec.md section 5): discovery no longer chooses a route and `alternatives` is deprecated (the catalogue replaces it; old records still carry it). A step with longRunning true is started in the background (nohup, pid captured), its checks are probed, its log captured, and it is stopped at the end of the route; the record stores startedSec (time to the first successful probe) instead of sec. Check types added for services, APIs and test suites: port_listens {port} passes when the port accepts a connection within 60 s; http_200 {port, path} passes when curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:<port><path> exits 0 within the step timeout (the body's first 200 chars are recorded); tests_passed {pattern?} passes when exit is 0 and stdout matches the runner's summary line (pytest: \d+ passed; jest: Tests:.*passed; go test: ^ok\b; cargo test: test result: ok) or the pattern. Commands are verbatim from the repository; a flag is added only if the README itself adds it for this hardware. A step without a `source` is rejected. CHECK RULES (apply to every check): `stdout_matches`, `metric_decreased` and `metric_below` patterns are Python regular expressions applied with re.MULTILINE, so `^` and `$` match at every line, to the step's whole stdout+stderr. `metric_decreased` takes the FIRST and LAST match in order of appearance (capture group 1, compared as floats) and passes when last < first. `metric_below` compares the LAST match to `value` (passes when last < value). `files_exist` paths are relative to the repository root in the sandbox. `exit_zero` passes when the step's rc is 0.

prerequisites.description: routeIds this route depends on (from the catalogue); their steps are inlined as this route's first steps, sourced from the prerequisite route

install.description: Install commands. When discovery trims the README's install line to the packages the route's scripts import (static scan of each step's script and the local modules it imports), `trimmedFrom` holds the README's full line.

source.description: where in the repository the command came from, e.g. README.md:85
